item.heralisz_grenade.c4.desc: Remote explosive, sticks and detonates from afar.
item.heralisz_grenade.flash_grenade.desc:
Blinds with intense light and deafens with loud noise,
turn away or keep distance to avoid.
item.heralisz_grenade.m67.desc:
Classic fragmentation grenade, pull the pin and throw,
deals area damage on explosion.
item.heralisz_grenade.molotov.desc: Molotov cocktail, ignites the area on impact.
item.heralisz_grenade.rgn.desc: Soviet offensive grenade with a large kill radius.
item.heralisz_grenade.smoke_grenade.desc:
Releases a large smoke screen,
blocks vision for cover and movement.
